name: popsicle
headline: MarketSpec: AI Marketing Content Spec Tool
short_description: MarketSpec is a spec-driven CLI tool that helps marketing teams create consistent, on-brand materials by defining specifications, then generating and validating content with AI assistants like Claude.
author: gaidar

sections.overview:
MarketSpec is a CLI tool designed for marketing teams to create consistent, on-brand marketing materials using AI assistants. It centralizes brand foundations—voice, messaging, audience profiles, and guidelines—then uses those specs to generate context-rich prompts and validate AI-generated content. The tool organizes work by campaign, provides pre-built templates for emails, landing pages, social posts, blog articles, and more, and integrates directly with Claude Code via slash commands. Teams can generate content variations, apply feedback, and validate materials against brand guidelines in a single workflow.
Generate on-brand email campaigns with AI while maintaining consistent voice and messaging
Create landing page copy that validates against brand guidelines before publishing
Manage multiple marketing campaigns with templated specs for different content types
Validate AI-generated social posts, ad copy, and blog articles against brand standards
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/gaidar/marketspec`
sections.usage:
```
Create a marketing framework for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Include target audience analysis, content pillars, and distribution channels. Use [DATA] to inform your recommendations.
```
Copy

# Marketing Framework for GreenTech Solutions
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
